# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 80 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 80

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever has come to know the world has found the body, and whoever has found the body — the world is not worthy of him."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- **ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ** / *pkosmos*: "the world" — used negatively throughout Thomas
- **ⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ** / *psōma*: "the body" — here used negatively, as the material/corporeal trap
- The saying is a near-parallel to Saying 56, which uses "corpse" (*ptōma*) instead of "body"
- To know the world is to discover the body — both are material realities that must be transcended
- "The world is not worthy of him" — the world is below the one who has made this discovery
- The discovery of materiality's nature leads to transcendence of it
